caption: The drawing depicts a dark-colored, metallic teapot with a tall, conical body, a curved spout on the left, and a rounded handle on the right. The teapot is decorated with a circular motif in the center of its body, featuring red and yellow floral designs with green stems or leaves, surrounded by an ornamental yellow border. The lid of the teapot is domed with a small knob on top and has similar yellow decorative patterns as seen elsewhere on the teapot, particularly near the rim and base, where yellow embellishments are repeated. The background is a plain beige or off-white color with scattered brownish spots and marks. The overall composition centers the teapot, and there are no other objects depicted in the drawing.
title: Toleware Coffee Pot
